description: Fork of exp593 (1.4337 SoTA). Vanilla-equivalent qk_lut: H=1, tph=256, n_out=H_attn*2*d_qk=768 (=6*128). Reshape output [B*T, 1, 768] -> [B*T, 6, 128] before q_norm/k_norm. Single routing decision per table position serves all 6 attention heads via output partition (like vanilla W_q being one matrix sliced into heads). Param-matched to exp593 baseline qk (3.15M/layer, 18.87M total), bandwidth-matched (6.29 Mbits/layer, 37.7 Mbits trunk), gradient-coverage-matched (512 tokens/row at bs=16). Differences vs exp593 multi-head qk: routing decisions per token 1536 -> 256 (6x fewer), routing entropy 6144 -> 1024 bits/token (6x less), per-row atom width 128 -> 768 (6x wider). Tests whether per-head routing diversity (exp593) is load-bearing or whether shared routing (vanilla-style) suffices.
